content.how_work_p1: Each color channel (R, G, B) is converted from a 0-255 decimal to a 00-FF hexadecimal value.
content.how_work_p2: The hex string is split into pairs and each pair is converted back to a 0-255 decimal value.

practices_list: Use HEX for compact CSS file sizes.
Use RGB (specifically RGBA) when you need opacity/transparency.
Stick to one format within a single project for consistency.
content.pro_tip_desc: HEX shorthand: Colors like #FF0000 can be shortened to #F00 when each pair of digits is identical.

faq.q1: What's the difference between RGB and HEX?
faq.a1: RGB uses decimal numbers (0-255) for each color channel, while HEX uses hexadecimal (00-FF).
faq.q2: Can I use RGB in CSS?
faq.a2: Yes! CSS supports both rgb(255, 0, 0) and #FF0000.
faq.q3: What does the # symbol mean in HEX codes?
faq.a3: The # symbol indicates that the following characters are a hexadecimal color code.
faq.q4: Are 3-digit and 6-digit HEX codes the same?
faq.a4: 3-digit HEX codes are shorthand for 6-digit codes where each digit is doubled.
